dsrebirth.config.auroraOptions.tooltip: Configuration options for aurora (northern lights) rendering
dsrebirth.config.blockEffects.blockEffec: Distance that will be scanned when generating block effects. Changing this setting will cause existing effects to be reset and the area rescanned.
dsrebirth.config.blockEffects.dustJetEna: Enable/disable dust falling from floating blocks (like dirt ledges)
dsrebirth.config.blockEffects.enableEnch: Enable/disable enchanting table book open and page turn sounds
dsrebirth.config.blockEffects.enableMagm: Enable/disable steam/smoke when rain hits magma or netherrack
dsrebirth.config.blockEffects.enableWate: Enable/disable particles from waterfalls. Sound effects will still happen if enabled. If you want to turn off waterfalls use the option 'Enable Waterfall Sounds'.
Enable/disable waterfall sound effects.  Particle effects will still happen if enabled. If you want to turn off waterfalls use the option 'Enable Waterfall Sounds'.
dsrebirth.config.blockEffects.fallingBlo: Enable/disable dust clouds kicked up when sand or gravel lands
dsrebirth.config.blockEffects.flameJetEn: Enable/disable flame jets produced over lava and nether wart
dsrebirth.config.blockEffects.furnaceIgn: Enable/disable the furnace ignite sound effect
dsrebirth.config.blockEffects.steamColum: Enable/disable steam column effect when liquids hit hot sources
dsrebirth.config.blockEffects.waterRippl: The style of water ripple to render when a drop hits a fluid. Commonly happens with rainfall and water splashes.
dsrebirth.config.blockEffects.waterfallM: Caps the volume of each waterfall sound loop (0-1). Large caves stack many waterfall loops; lower this if they get too loud
dsrebirth.config.blockEffects.waterfalls: Enable/disable waterfall effect from flowing water
Enable/disable display of the clock display when holding a clock item. The time information will be displayed above the hot bar.
Enable/disable display of the compass display when holding a compass item. Compass heading will be displayed above the crosshair.
Enable/disable the red pulsing frame on the selected hotbar slot when the item's durability is low
Enable/disable showing the horizontal distance to the treasure target on explorer maps
Durability percentage at or below which the highlight shows
Scales the compass rendering by the specified amount
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.backgrou: Number of background threads to use for enhanced sound processing. Do not arbitrarily change this value because it could impact performance.
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.bandFreq: Occlusion only: the octave bands in Hz the Fresnel zone is measured in, lowest first. The zone radius scales as 1/sqrt(frequency), so the lowest band decides whether a large obstacle (a hill) is a wall or a nuisance. '/dstune bandFrequencies 63,250,1000' shifts the whole model down an octave
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.bandWeig: Occlusion only: relative weight of each octave band (lowest first) when the per-band attenuations are combined. The defaults (0.50 low, 0.35 mid, 0.15 high) follow the principle that low frequencies are the ones that reach the listener around an obstacle; they are a judgement call rather than a measured spectrum, so they are exposed for testing. '/dstune bandWeights 0.7,0.25,0.05' makes a hill even more transparent
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.enableCh: Experimental. Tries to free sound channels that have become stuck. Off by default because it can crash the game - only turn this on if someone asks you to test it
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.enableEn: Enable/disable enhanced sound processing (reverb, occlusion, etc)
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.enableMo: Enable/disable on the fly conversion of stereo sounds to mono as needed. This function will only be active when 'Enhanced Sound Processing' is enabled.
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.enableOc: Enable/disable sound occlusion processing (sound muffling behind blocks). Enabling will cause additional processing by the background workers, and on lower end computer systems may cause performance issues.
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.enableWa: Enable/disable damping for sounds whose path to the player passes through water. Reduces both volume and high frequencies (muffling).
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.evaluate: Evaluate the environment on the sound thread when a sound starts (default: correct occlusion/reverb on the very first frame) or defer it to the background worker (less sound-thread work when many sounds start in the same tick, at the cost of up to one worker cycle - 50 ms - of default settings at the start of each sound)
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.logAudio: Diagnostics: write the audio evaluation trace to the log (about one line every 250 ms while sounds are being processed). Off by default so a normal session stays quiet; '/dstune probe true' turns it on for a session, and '/dstune' always shows the most recent trace whether or not this is on
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.occlusio: Occlusion only: segments a source-to-player ray is split into when measuring how much block material it passes through. Higher = finer distance-weighted occlusion at slightly more cost per ray
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.realismF: Occlusion only: the representative frequency in Hz used for the wavelength above. The engine applies ONE low-pass filter per source, so the model has to pick a single band; 500 Hz is a low-mid voice/thud band, where a game's audible occlusion is dominated, and it makes the model generous (low frequencies bend around obstacles) rather than harsh
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.realismW: Occlusion only: use the real wavelength of sound instead of treating every frequency alike. Diffraction loss then follows the Fresnel number of the detour around the obstacle's edge (low frequencies bend around obstacles, high frequencies do not). This is the physically correct direction, and the reason a low rumble carries around a corner while a high clink does not. Turn off to get the previous frequency-blind behaviour back
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.reverbBo: The maximum number of reflections that will be made for a given reverb ray. Higher values will increase CPU use and improves fidelity. Lower numbers reduce CPU and decreases fidelity.
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.reverbIn: Scales the reverb (echo) intensity (1.0 = default; 0 = no reverb; higher = stronger)
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.reverbRa: Total distance, in blocks, that a ray will travel when calculating reverb. Higher values will increases CPU use and improves fidelity. Lower numbers reduce CPU and decreases fidelity.

The number of rays to project from a sound location when calculating a reverb effect. Higher values increases CPU use and improves fidelity. Lower numbers reduce CPU and decreases fidelity. This would be the primary setting to tweak when managing performance.
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.tooltip: Configuration options for enhanced sound processing (reverb, etc.)
dsrebirth.config.enhancedSounds.waterSou: Fraction of the sound's volume that passes through each block of water between the sound and the player. Lower values make sounds crossing water quieter. The volume never drops below a minimum, so distant sounds stay audible. A value of 1.0 disables the volume change.

High-frequency (muffling) cut-off per block of water between the sound and the player. Lower values make underwater sounds more muffled, which is how sound really behaves through water. A value of 1.0 disables the muffling.
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.enableBre: Enable/disable breath effect in cold biomes
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.enableBru: Enable/disable sound effect when walking through dense brush
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.enableCra: Enable/disable crafting sound when an item is crafted
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.enableCre: Enable/disable footprints for creatures (villagers, animals, mobs). The 1.12.2 original gave every living entity footprints; this port only produced them for the player, so this restores that behaviour and can be turned off if the extra particles are unwanted
Enable/disable creature footsteps: per-creature material footsteps with volume, cadence, landing and stop sounds (ported from the original 1.12.2 system)
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.enableFoo: Enable/disable the footstep sound system entirely (walking/running material sounds)
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.enablePla: Enable/disable heartbeat sound when the player's health is low
Enable/disable stomach growl sound when the player is hungry
Enable/disable jump sound when the player leaves the ground
Enable/disable landing sound when the player falls from a height
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.enablePro: Enable/disable thrown projectile break sounds (ender pearl, egg, snowball)
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.enableSne: Play footstep sounds while sneaking. The original 1.12.2 mod was completely silent while sneaking; turn this off to get that behaviour back
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.enableSto: Play a short scuff sound when you stop or turn around suddenly. Turn off if you find it distracting
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.enableSwi: Enable/disable item swing sound effects from players and mobs
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.enableToo: Enable/disable sound effects for blocks on the toolbar
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.entityEff: The maximum range at which entity special effects are applied. Keep in mind that sound and particle effects have their own respective ranges within the Minecraft game engine.
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.inferFoot: Pick a footstep sound for blocks added by other mods by looking at their name, so a modded sandstone sounds like sand instead of plain stone. Blocks with a sound set by hand are never changed
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.playerHun: Food level (hunger bar) at or below which the stomach growl plays (0 disables)
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.playerHur: Fraction of max health below which the heartbeat sound plays (0 disables)
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.showCritW: Display a comic power word when an entity takes a critical hit
dsrebirth.config.entityEffects.showDamag: Display damage and healing numbers above entities
dsrebirth.config.fogOptions.biomeFogDens: Scales biome fog density (1.0 = default; 0 = disable biome fog)
dsrebirth.config.fogOptions.enableAfterR: A thin haze left behind for a while after the rain stops.
dsrebirth.config.fogOptions.enableBiomeF: Enable/disable biome fog effect. Fog color and intensity is determined by biome configuration.
dsrebirth.config.fogOptions.enableElevat: Higher the player elevation the more haze that is experienced
dsrebirth.config.fogOptions.morningFogDe: Scales morning fog haze (4.0 = default; higher = mist reaches closer; does not change view distance). The morning fog type follows the season sub-phase deterministically - midsummer mornings have no fog
dsrebirth.config.fogOptions.morningFogEn: Morning fog end time in hours of day (8.0 = 8AM)
dsrebirth.config.fogOptions.morningFogPe: Morning fog peak time in hours of day (6.0 = 6AM)
dsrebirth.config.fogOptions.morningFogSt: Morning fog start time in hours of day (5.0 = 5AM, 6.0 = 6AM, 8.0 = 8AM)
dsrebirth.config.fogOptions.weatherFogDe: Scales weather (rain) fog density (1.0 = default; higher = denser/closer fog)
dsrebirth.config.footstepAccents.enableA: Enable/disable accents for armor that is worn
dsrebirth.config.footstepAccents.enableF: Enable/disable accents for when the player is walking on squeaky blocks
dsrebirth.config.footstepAccents.enableW: Enable/disable accents for when it is raining or blocks are waterlogged
dsrebirth.config.footstepAccents.inferAr: Give armor from other mods a footstep accent based on how heavy it is. Armor with a sound set by hand is never changed
dsrebirth.config.footstepAccents.tooltip: Configuration options for footstep accent effects
dsrebirth.config.logging.enableDebugLogg: Enables/disables debug logging of the mod
dsrebirth.config.logging.enableModUpdate: Enable/disable chat window notification when newer mod versions are available
dsrebirth.config.logging.filteredTagView: Enable/disable filtering of tags in the diagnostic overlay. If enabled, tag listings will be filtered to only those belonging to loader frameworks as well as Minecraft and this mod. If disabled, all tags will be shown.
dsrebirth.config.logging.registerCommand: Enable/disable registration of client side commands. Disabling may provide broadest level of support when using the mod with other loaders, such as Quilt.
dsrebirth.config.logging.tooltip: Configuration options for modifying diagnostic behavior
dsrebirth.config.logging.traceMask.toolt: Bitmask for toggling various debug traces
dsrebirth.config.otherOptions.playRandom: Enable/disable playing random sound at the Minecraft finish loading to main screen
dsrebirth.config.particleTweaks.suppress: Enable/disable showing of projectile particle trails on critical strikes
dsrebirth.config.particleTweaks.tooltip: Configuration options for tweaking particle behavior
dsrebirth.config.popoffNumbers.driftPerc: How far the text drifts sideways, as a percentage of the original mod's launch. Positive drifts away from the attacker, negative toward it, 0 rises straight up
dsrebirth.config.popoffNumbers.gravityPe: How fast the text drops, as a percentage of the original mod's gravity. Lower falls more slowly and travels less; raise it for a heavier drop
dsrebirth.config.popoffNumbers.growFacto: How fast the text grows, in percent per tick. It grows only up to the peak tick, then shrinks slowly back to the size it started
dsrebirth.config.popoffNumbers.lifetimeT: How long the text lives in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Longer values hang in the air for longer, which makes the camera's own movement dominate what you see
dsrebirth.config.popoffNumbers.maxScaleP: Size at which it starts shrinking
Upper guard on the text size, as a percentage of the spawn size. The animation stays below this unless the growth is set unreasonably high
dsrebirth.config.popoffNumbers.peakTickT: Which tick the text reaches its largest. Low values grow fast and then shrink slowly; the shrink rate is derived so the text ends at the size it started
dsrebirth.config.popoffNumbers.sizePerce: Size of the damage, healing and crit text as a percentage of the original mod's size. This sets the STARTING size; the text grows to about 2.5x that at its peak
dsrebirth.config.popoffNumbers.tooltip: Settings for the damage, healing and critical-hit text that pops off an entity
dsrebirth.config.soundOptions.allowScary: Enables playing scary sounds. Scary can be subjective. It is up to mod pack authors to implement properly within the configuration. Disliked sounds also be blocked using the in-game sound configuration menu.
dsrebirth.config.soundOptions.ambientVol: Ambient sounds played by the mod will be multiplied by this factor. The unit scale is 1/100, so a setting of 100 would multiply by 1. Volume calculations have several different factors, this setting being one of them. Regardless of these factors, the final volume will be restricted to a range of 0.0 - 1.0.
dsrebirth.config.soundOptions.biomeVolum: Biome ambient sounds will be multiplied by this factor
dsrebirth.config.soundOptions.displayToa: Enables the display of toast notifications for music that has a requirement for attribution. Please see the CREDITS.md file on Github for details.
dsrebirth.config.soundOptions.enableBack: Enable/disable distant background thunder rumbling during storms
dsrebirth.config.soundOptions.enableBiom: Enable/disable ambient biome and village sounds (forest, plains, crickets, etc.)
dsrebirth.config.soundOptions.footstepVo: Footstep sounds will be multiplied by this factor
dsrebirth.config.soundOptions.playBiomeM: Enables playing configured biome background music when in creative mode. Normally while in creative mode, Minecraft's situational music selector will automatically pick creative music rather than biome background music.
dsrebirth.config.soundOptions.playerEffe: Player effect sounds (jump, heartbeat, hunger, crafting, hotbar, item swing) will be multiplied by this factor
dsrebirth.config.soundOptions.remapSound: Enables sound remapping when sounds are played. Enabling tells Dynamic Surroundings to replace various step sounds with replacement versions.
dsrebirth.config.soundOptions.replaceThu: Enables replacement of thunder sounds with Dynamic Surroundings' version
dsrebirth.config.soundOptions.tooltip: Options for defining how Dynamic Surroundings generate sound effects
dsrebirth.config.soundSystem.cullInterva: Ticks between culled sound events (0 to disable culling)
dsrebirth.config.soundSystem.enableSound: Enables/disables cancellation of sound that a player will not hear. Does not apply to global, non-attenuated, or WEATHER sounds.
dsrebirth.config.soundSystem.tooltip: Configuration options for modifying Minecraft's Sound System behavior

Off by default
dsrebirth.config.speechBubbles.enableSpe:
Enable/disable speech bubbles above player heads for chat messages
Off by default
dsrebirth.config.speechBubbles.speechBub: Number of seconds to display a speech bubble before removing it
Range (blocks) at which a speech bubble is visible
dsrebirth.config.speechBubbles.tooltip: Settings for the speech bubbles drawn above player and entity heads
dsrebirth.config.title: Dynamic Surroundings Configuration Options
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.disableF: Turn plant layers off while a shader pack is active.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.enableBi: Tint the fog with the biome color.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.enableDe: Dust storm and yellow screen tint in deserts.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.enableDi: Let Distant Horizons terrain fog with the weather too.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.enableFo: Rain beads hanging on grass and flowers.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.enableGr: Master switch. On: rain and snow vary by biome and season. Off: vanilla rain and snow.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.enableIc: Icicles growing under eaves while it snows, and melting afterwards.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.enableMa: Rain sounds different on glass, metal and wood.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.enableMo: Dew on plants before dawn, gone by mid-morning.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.enableSk: Overcast and clear-sky weather on dry days.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.enableSn: Snow settling on grass and flowers while it snows.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.enableWa: Water dripping from eaves and overhangs while it rains.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.enableWi: Wind that rises with the rain and storm.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.foliageD: How much snow, dew and rain beads plants carry. 1.0 is standard.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.foliageS: How far around you plants get snow and dew, in blocks. Bigger costs more performance.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.gradedRa: On: draw rain on top of Particle Rain. Off (recommended): let Particle Rain handle rain.
dsrebirth.config.weatherOptions.tooltip: Rain and snow, their sounds, what they leave behind, sky events and fog

dsrebirth.text.quickvolume.title: Quick Sound Volume
dsrebirth.text.soundconfig.block.help: Enabling Block will prevent sounds with the resource ID from playing. Blocking also applies to Dynamic Surrounding sounds. Will only apply to sounds played through the Minecraft sound engine.
dsrebirth.text.soundconfig.cull.help: Enabling Cull will limit the number of plays with the same resource ID from queueing over a short period of time, reducing the overall load of the sound engine as well as ears. Useful around mob farms. Will only apply to sounds played through the Minecraft sound engine.
dsrebirth.text.soundconfig.play.help: Play the sound with the volume scaled by the volume scaling factor. Does not apply sound category volume modifiers.
dsrebirth.text.soundconfig.subtitle: Subtitle:
dsrebirth.text.soundconfig.volume.help: Volume scaling factor applied when calculating the output volume of a sound. Increase to make quiet sounds louder; reduce to make loud sounds quieter. 100% is normal volume.
